title: Lazar's missing records and the Los Alamos phone book
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: mistaken or were lying. A 1982 phone book from the lab lists Lazar right there among the other scientists and technicians.

plain: Doubters said they could find no record that Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked as a scientist on government projects, ever worked at Los Alamos National Laboratory, the US government's weapons research lab in New Mexico. The journalist George Knapp answers that the doubters "were mistaken or were lying," because "a 1982 phone book from the lab lists Lazar right there among the other scientists and technicians." If so, Lazar did work at the lab, even though his other records seem to be missing.
